text:
maria: Quick brain dump — want to separate transient vs sustained errors in the autoswitch (we're calling it 'detour' internally). UX needs: clear trigger window, preview of requests that would detour, and an immutable audit event. Thoughts?

ajay: yes. two notes: 1) transient = spike that resolves in < X seconds, don't change model routing; 2) sustained = persistent problem, switch. need configurable windows.

dana: can we show a small example in console? i.e. a timeline slider to replay last N minutes and highlight which requests would have detoured. :eyes:

leah: +1 for replay. also need to show "why" per decision — e.g. error_class=502, rate=0.08, median latency=1.2s — otherwise SREs will revert blindly.

sam: UX question — do we expose both a default sensible policy and an "expert" advanced policy? most customers will want safe defaults.

maria: agree on defaults. default thresholds: error_rate > 5% for 120s -> sustained. transient: error_rate > 10% for 30s but only sample N=20 requests. open to tweaks.

ajay: proto of rule syntax I sketched:
```
fallback_rule:
  name: "detour-on-sustained-errors"
  trigger:
    metric: "error_rate"
    window: "120s"
    threshold: 0.05
  mode: "route_to_fallback"
  fallback_model: "gptx-small-quant"
```
can the console show this humanized?

dana: yep — show both raw YAML and a friendly sentence: "If >5% errors for 2m, route 100% to fallback." Also show estimated cost delta and latency change.

leah: audit: every detour decision should emit an event with immutable id + exact inputs (sanitized) + decision factors. make it downloadable as CSV for compliance.

sam: what about oscillation? if primary flaps, we might switch back and forth. we need hysteresis: min switch time and cooldown. also show predicted impact of hysteresis in preview.

maria: good call. UI affordances:
- preview mode (replay N minutes)
- simulation mode (dry-run; counts but doesn't route)
- make audit events searchable by route/model/error_class
- quick rollback button on rollbackable policies

ajay: internal API note — fallback decisions should be idempotent and include decision_context token so we can correlate with traces. API: POST /policies/preview with time_range -> returns list of decisions + reasons.

dana: small mock: "Preview returned 14 detours (10 sustained, 4 transient). Click a detour to inspect requests." allow filtering.

leah: also add a small explainer tooltip: "Transient = short spike. Sustained = long-running degradation. We default to sustained to avoid unnecessary model churn."

maria: ops ask: include operator annotation on audit logs: allow owner to add "I escalated to infra" free text and it becomes part of the immutable record.

sam: UX edgecase — what if fallback itself errors? show multi-stage fallback chain and ensure we never create loops. console should visualize chain graph.

ajay: implementation constraints: need to sample KV cache keys when capturing inputs (PII) — must strip PII before writing audit. security will require KMS note.

maria: next steps: ajay to draft API contract for preview + dry-run, dana to wire a minimal console mock for replay + reasons, leah to write audit fields + retention policy, sam to propose default thresholds and hysteresis. I'll collect and we iterate.

deploy-bot: policy "detour-on-sustained-errors" sandbox preview run started (id: preview-1712348888-1) :rocket:

maria: thanks — can everyone drop a 1-line blocker if you hit one by EOD?
